correctness.rationale: Using P(A)=[1+cos(2theta)cos alpha]/2 and P(AB)=[1+cos(2theta)(cos alpha+cos beta)+cos alpha cos beta+sin(2theta)sin alpha sin beta]/4, substitute the source I3322 polynomial and M_A=P(A1)-1. Independent SymPy Taylor series in t=sqrt(theta) directly returned Q theta^2,theta^3,theta^4 coefficients 4/3,-25/9,-1/9 and M_A=-theta^2+(1/3)theta^4, then series division gave eta 3/7+25theta/49+562theta^2/1029. Independent symbolic expansion in the general six-parameter scaling produced q4=-(a^2 f^2+8af+6b^2-8b+6d^2+8d+4u^2)/16, equal to the displayed sum-of-squares form q4=4/3-(af+4)^2/16-3(b-2/3)^2/8-3(d+2/3)^2/8-u^2/4, with no c in leading order. Loss leading coefficient is 1+u^2/4; therefore q4/(1+u^2/4)<=4/3 with equality iff four conditions hold. Analyticity of trig expressions and theta>0 ensure the expansions and strict positive Q for sufficiently small theta. No claim of arbitrary-scaling optimality.
